text: Testing plays an important role in software development. Unit tests check small parts of the code, like individual functions, to make sure they work correctly. Integration tests go further and check how different parts of the system work together. Many developers also use test-driven development, where they write tests before writing the actual code. This approach helps them think clearly about what the code should do. Good testing gives developers confidence. When tests pass, they know their changes have not broken anything. This confidence makes it easier to improve the code and release new versions without fear.
